config.name: SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY
config.description: Optional API key for Semantic Scholar to enable higher rate limits.

tools.name: arxiv_search_papers
tools.description: Search arXiv for papers using advanced query syntax.

params.name: query
params.description: The search keywords or structured arXiv query string (e.g., 'au:vaswani AND ti:attention').

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of search results to skip, used for paginating through large result sets.

params.name: date_to
params.description: Filter results to papers published on or before this date (format: YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: sort_by
params.description: The criteria used to order the search results.

params.name: date_from
params.description: Filter results to papers published on or after this date (format: YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: categories
params.description: A list of arXiv category codes (e.g., 'cs.LG') or natural language subject names to filter by.

params.name: max_results
params.description: The maximum number of papers to return in the results list (up to 50).

params.name: output_format
params.description: The desired format for the tool's response output.

tools.name: arxiv_get_paper
tools.description: Fetch complete metadata for a specific arXiv paper.

params.name: arxiv_id
params.description: The unique arXiv identifier (e.g., '1706.03762') or the full arXiv.org URL.

params.name: output_format
params.description: Choose between human-readable markdown or structured JSON data.

tools.name: arxiv_get_papers_batch
tools.description: Retrieve metadata for multiple papers in a single call.

params.name: arxiv_ids
params.description: A list containing up to 20 arXiv identifiers or full URLs.

params.name: output_format
params.description: The format of the final response (markdown or JSON).

tools.name: arxiv_download_and_extract
tools.description: Extract full text from a paper's PDF.

params.name: arxiv_id
params.description: The arXiv ID of the paper from which to extract text.

params.name: end_page
params.description: The 1-indexed page number where text extraction should stop.

params.name: start_page
params.description: The 1-indexed page number where text extraction should begin.

params.name: max_characters
params.description: The maximum number of characters to return from the PDF to prevent context window overflow.

params.name: include_sections
params.description: Whether to include an automatically detected outline of the paper's sections.

params.name: include_references
params.description: Whether to include the bibliography list extracted from the end of the PDF.

tools.name: arxiv_get_references
tools.description: List the papers that this paper cites.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of outbound references to retrieve.

params.name: arxiv_id
params.description: The arXiv ID of the paper whose references you wish to explore.

params.name: output_format
params.description: The desired output format for the reference list.

tools.name: arxiv_get_citations
tools.description: List newer papers that have cited this paper.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of inbound citations to retrieve.

params.name: arxiv_id
params.description: The arXiv ID of the paper to check for inbound citations.

params.name: output_format
params.description: The desired output format for the citation list.

params.name: group
params.description: An optional arXiv group code (e.g., 'cs') or a natural language search term (e.g., 'robotics').

params.name: output_format
params.description: The desired output format for the category list.

tools.name: arxiv_cache_stats
tools.description: View internal cache hit rates and sizes.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Optional flag to show detailed stats.

prompts.name: summarize_paper
prompts.description: Generate a high-quality structured summary using extracted full text.

prompts.name: compare_papers
prompts.description: Perform a side-by-side analysis of 2-5 arXiv papers.

prompts.name: literature_review
prompts.description: Synthesize a professional literature review for a research topic.

resources.name: arXiv Taxonomy
resources.description: A full list of arXiv subject category codes and their descriptions.

resources.name: Query Syntax Guide
resources.description: A reference guide for advanced search operators like ti:, au:, and boolean logic.

resources.name: Server Info
resources.description: An overview of the server's version, tools, and citations data source.
